scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=ui-frontend && npm run build --workspace=ui-backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=ui-frontend && npm run lint --workspace=ui-backend
scripts.sdk:build: npm run build --prefix packages/ticketing-sdk && npm run build --prefix packages/ticketing-ui
scripts.sdk:publish: npm publish --prefix packages/ticketing-sdk --access public && npm publish --prefix packages/ticketing-ui --access public
scripts.test:layers: cd ai-agents && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_layer1_workflow_manager.py tests/test_layer2_auth_boundary.py tests/test_layer4_regression_transcripts.py tests/test_layer5_contracts.py tests/test_layer6_security.py tests/test_rbac_live_scope.py -q
scripts.test:integration: cd ai-agents && RUN_INTEGRATION=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m integration tests/test_layer3_e2e_chat.py -q
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:agents && npm run test:filters && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:modules && npm run test:chat && npm run test:scenarios
scripts.test:strict:all: npm run test:strict && node scripts/strict-flow-bug-hunt.mjs && node scripts/strict-loophole-hunt.mjs && npm run test:strict:dual
